mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE score >= 80) AS high_intent, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND stage IN ('QUALIFIED', 'DISCOVERY', 'DEMO', 'PROPOSAL', 'NEGOTIATION') ) AS active_opportunities, round(coalesce(avg(score), 0), 1) AS average_score FROM ( SELECT status, stage, CASE WHEN coalesce(attributes ->> 'score', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (attributes ->> 'score')::integer ELSE 0 END AS score FROM customer WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ) scoped_customer

SELECT member.id, app_user.display_name AS name FROM organization_member member JOIN app_user ON app_user.id = member.user_id WHERE member.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND app_user.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY app_user.display_name
